hookSpecificOutput.additionalContext: ARCHITECTURE-GOVERNED PROJECT: ARCHITECTURE.md is at the project root, so its architecture files are maintained through the solution-architect plugin skills. Before any Edit or Write to ARCHITECTURE.md, docs/**, adr/** or tdr/**, invoke the skill that owns the file: architecture-docs for ARCHITECTURE.md and docs/**; architecture-component-guardian for docs/components/README.md and component add / remove / rename; architecture-definition-record for adr/**; technical-debt-records for tdr/**. The skills run validation gates (the Section 3 principle gate, downstream propagation, source attribution, the semver bump, index drift) that a direct edit skips. Questions about the documented architecture are answered through architecture-docs (read-only). Every other architecture task (diagrams, release, compliance, analysis, handoff, export, 3D view) routes by the skill descriptions.
